reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Cream Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid with Sh-EGF 80mL Special Set (Special Gift: 20mL)
reviews.text: The Torriden Dive-In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Cream is an amazing lightweight moisturizer! The gel-cream texture absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy, yet it gives long-lasting hydration. My skin feels soft, smooth, and deeply moisturized after every use. It’s perfect for both day and night, especially for those with dehydrated or sensitive skin. I love how it leaves my skin calm, plump, and fresh — definitely one of my favorite hydrating creams! 💦
reviews.zh: Torriden Dive-In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Cream 係一款超讚嘅輕盈保濕霜！gel-cream 質地吸收得快，唔會覺得油笠或者厚重，但又做到持久保濕。每次用完之後皮膚都感覺柔軟、幼滑，而且深層保濕。日頭定夜晚都用得，尤其適合缺水或者敏感肌。我好鍾意用完之後皮膚感覺平靜、飽滿又清新——絕對係我最愛嘅保濕霜之一！💦

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Cream Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid with Sh-EGF 80mL Special Set (Special Gift: 20mL)
reviews.text: It's a brand famous for its moisture, right? I've used all of the serum, toner, and cream. I bought it because the tube type looked easy to use. It also inclued with a small size. It looks good to use for short-term trips. I'm satisfied with all of this brand's products in general.
reviews.zh: 呢個品牌一向以保濕見稱㗎嘛？我用過佢哋成條線嘅精華、爽膚水同面霜。揀呢支係因為 tube 裝用起上嚟好似好方便。仲附送細裝添。短途旅行用應該幾啱。整體而言，呢個品牌嘅產品我都用得好滿意。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Cream Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid with Sh-EGF 80mL Special Set (Special Gift: 20mL)
reviews.text: Accidentally ordered instead of the soothing cream. This cream is a little thicker, perfect for dry mountain climates or winter weather. I prefer a more gel like consistency in the summer, but this cream still absorbs very quickly for being thicker. Skin looks glassy after use. Better for dry/sensitive skin that for oily skin.
reviews.zh: 原本想買舒緩霜但手滑落錯單。呢款面霜質地厚少少，適合乾燥山區氣候或者冬天用。夏天我會比較鍾意 gel 狀質地，但呢款雖然厚但都吸收得幾快。用完皮膚望落好似玻璃面咁。乾性／敏感肌用好過油性肌用。

reviews.text: I love this face gel cream so much! It absorbs quickly and leave my skin moisturized with no sticky feeling. Great moisturizer before makeup during summer time! It calms my skin and doesn’t not cause any breakouts. My face looks pumped with water and glowy, not oily!
reviews.zh: 我超鍾意呢款面gel cream！吸收得快，用完之後皮膚保濕得嚟又冇黏笠感。夏天化妝前用係一流嘅保濕！可以舒緩皮膚，而且完全唔會爆瘡。塊面望落好似飲飽水咁水潤有光澤，但又唔會油笠笠！

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Cream Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid with Sh-EGF 80mL Special Set (Special Gift: 20mL)
reviews.text: This is the best moisturizer. I also use the torriden serum with this product. They are the best combo. When I apply this product on my face it immediately cools my face. My face becomes so cold and I love it. It makes it easier to apply foundation on my face because my face is cold. I would definitely recommend this product to my friends. I also have a very sensitive skin and this product is so good with me.
reviews.zh: 呢個係最好嘅保濕霜。我仲會配搭 torriden 精華一齊用。佢哋係最佳組合。一搽上面塊面即時有涼感。塊面變得冰涼，我好鍾意。因為塊面涼咗，上粉底都容易咗。一定會推介畀朋友用。我本身係敏感肌，但呢款產品同我用得好夾。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Cream Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid with Sh-EGF 80mL Special Set (Special Gift: 20mL)
reviews.text: This feels pretty similar to the Real Barrier Intense Hydration moisturizer except slightly lighter. If you liked the Real Barrier one but wanted something for the summer time or something a little simpler and lighter, this one’s great! As someone with drier skin, I like to follow up with the Physiogel DMT cream. It has great ingredients too!
reviews.zh: 呢款嘅感覺同 Real Barrier Intense Hydration 保濕霜幾相似，不過輕盈少少。如果你鍾意 Real Barrier 嗰款，但又想搵啲夏天用、簡單啲輕盈啲嘅嘢，呢款就啱晒！作為乾性肌嘅人，我會再疊一層 Physiogel DMT cream。成分都好勁！

reviews.text: My second time repurchasing, and definitely not my last. Next time I think I might just buy a few to keep stock and to give them away to friends and family. Torriden is a brand that just does everything right. This cream is light and very moisturising - does not leave any sticky or oily residue. As seen on the box, there the formula is very, very skin friendly and free of a lot of nasties. I have used it almost every night for 4+ months now, and I have not experienced any problems/troubles with my skin - so In can vouch for the fact that it is very non-irritating. There is no scent or colour. The last bottle I bought I mentioned that the lid didn't 'click' when closing - but the one I bought this time does, so it must be a luck thing. The only negative thing I can think of is that I wish they would release this in a bigger size!
reviews.zh: 已經係第二次回購，絕對唔會係最後一次。下次諗住一次過掃幾支，自己囤貨之餘仲可以送畀朋友同屋企人。Torriden 呢個品牌基本上每樣嘢都做得好。呢款面霜質地輕盈而且非常保濕——完全唔會留低任何黏笠或者油笠嘅殘留物。正如盒上面所講，配方非常、非常親膚，亦都避開咗好多有害成分。我而家幾乎每晚都用，已經用咗 4 個月以上，皮膚完全冇出過任何問題——所以我可以作實佢真係完全唔刺激。冇香味亦冇顏色。上一支我提過蓋合埋嘅時候唔會「click」一聲——但今次買嘅呢支會，所以應該係運氣問題。諗極諗到唯一嘅負面嘢，就係希望佢哋可以出大包裝！

reviews.text: Структура крема не плотная, но и не как гель, что-то среднее. Приятно голубого цвета. Легко наносится и впитывается, нет липкости, стянутости. Кожа напитанная и увлажнения, как будто упругая. Не скатывается и не стекает. Кожа сияет, но финиш матовый. То что надо для меня. У меня комбинированная кожа. Купила по отзывам и рейтингам. Пользуюсь всей линейкой, тонер и ампула.
reviews.zh: 面霜嘅結構唔算厚，但又唔似 gel，係兩者之間。顏色係幾舒服嘅藍色。容易搽同吸收，冇黏笠感、冇繃緊感。皮膚感覺飽水又保濕，好似有彈性。唔會搓出擦膠碎亦都唔會流走。皮膚有光澤，但係霧面妝效。啱晒我。我係混合性肌。睇住評價同排名買嘅。成條線都用緊，包括爽膚水同安瓶。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
